passīvus, passīva, passīvum

Declension on Wiktionary

verbum passīvum, a passive verb; genus passīvum, the passive voice. Quintilian also calls the passive patiendī modus, the mode of suffering, and says of a deponent that it habet nātūram patiendī (1.6.10).

Other words

  • patiendī modus — the passive voice

    also used · classical · Quint. 1.6.26: quōmodo autem quīre et ruere vel in praeterita patiendī modō … trānsībunt?; Quint. 9.3.7

Examples

  • Dīc passīvum. — Canor.

    Give the passive. — Canor.Traupman 241

See also voice, active, deponent, be, grammar, verb.
